details: Global oil prices are experiencing volatility as diplomatic efforts to de-escalate the Middle East conflict are counteracted by renewed Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabian oil facilities, notably the Ras Tanura refinery. This ongoing tension is sustaining a geopolitical premium in crude prices, which could fuel inflation and influence central bank monetary policy decisions, impacting global financial markets.
title: Middle East Diplomacy vs. Houthi Attacks: Oil Prices Volatile

details: The US Department of the Treasury has proposed new rules under the Comprehensive Outbound Investment National Security Act (COINS Act) to significantly expand restrictions on American investments in Chinese companies developing "super intelligence" AI systems and biotechnology. These measures, part of a broader national security strategy, are expected to increase compliance obligations for investors and financial institutions with exposure to China.
title: US Curbs Investments in Chinese AI & Biotech

details: The cryptocurrency industry has reportedly spent approximately $176 million across more than 100 US midterm races this election cycle. This aggressive financial outlay aims to build a bipartisan coalition in Congress to advance crypto interests and ensure favorable long-term regulatory frameworks, particularly as the industry prepares for the post-Trump era.
title: Crypto Spends Big to Influence US Midterms

details: Three South Korean financial firms, including major cryptocurrency exchange Bithumb, have reported data breaches. Bithumb is investigating whether customer personal information was leaked from its in-house mobile system, while brokerage Daishin Securities and asset manager Mirae Asset Global Investments also confirmed hacking incidents, raising concerns about cybersecurity in the financial sector.
title: South Korean Crypto Exchange Bithumb Hit by Data Breach

details: Luxor Technology, a Seattle-based provider of full-stack infrastructure services originally built around Bitcoin mining, has closed a $16 million strategic funding round led by CMT Digital. The investment aims to scale Luxor's AI compute infrastructure, leveraging its existing expertise in energy management and hardware brokerage to meet the growing demand for high-performance computing in the artificial intelligence sector.
title: Bitcoin Miner Luxor Technology Secures Funding for AI Infrastructure

details: The US Federal Reserve is expected to announce its October interest rate decision. While markets widely anticipate rates to remain unchanged, persistent inflation concerns, partly fueled by rising oil prices, could lead to a cautious stance from policymakers regarding future rate cuts. This monetary policy uncertainty is contributing to Bitcoin's recent weakness, with the cryptocurrency on track for its weakest October in six years.
title: Fed Rate Decision Looms, Bitcoin Under Pressure
